title: Final Proper Lifetime
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the proper lifetime of the D^0 particle as tau_0 = 9.3 x 10^-13 s.

title: Lorentz Factor Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately compute the Lorentz factor gamma using the total energy and mass of the D^0 particle.

title: Velocity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must determine the velocity beta of the D^0 particle in units of c correctly.

title: Decay Constant Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the decay constant lambda from the lifetime tau correctly.

title: Time Distribution Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must explain that the expected time distribution for both decay modes follows the same exponential form.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in calculations.

title: Branching Ratio Comparison
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the implications of different branching ratios on the decay time distribution.
